summary: Click Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its General Meeting held on June 30, 2026. Shareholders approved a share consolidation of Class A and Class B ordinary shares within a 1-for-4 to 1-for-30 range, with the exact ratio and effective date to be set by the Board within one year. Also approved were related amendments to the company's memorandum and articles of association. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or activist campaign is present; this is a routine corporate action vote.
